scope: Module 11 dynamic MatchChain leaf, no live Encoder controls
api: insert/candidates accept impl Into<MatchKey>; incompatible widths rejected before mutation
reset_from validates equal layout, active head lengths and source nodes <= destination nodes before copying
contracts: Node limit 1..=524288; visit limit 0..=64; zero visits permitted privately.
Every reserve precedes initialized-length/record/metadata publication. A failed second reserve can increase earlier head capacity but preserves every old logical element and traversal tag.
Retained allocation owners are used for resizing without clones; independent Clone domains and borrowed NonClone ownership are tested.
Unsafe accessors check the current initialized prefix rather than capacity or only requested metadata; reconfiguration is excluded by the live borrow.
Default output is compared with archived pre-change frames for all three named policies and strategy reuse.
